exposure: Mode of delivery preference (CSMR vs. vaginal delivery)
cohort: 202 pregnant women at the University Medical Centre Mannheim, University Heidelberg, Germany (93 women aiming for CSMR and 109 women seeking vaginal delivery)
finding: Compared to women seeking spontaneous delivery, women requesting CSMR had lower social support, were less educated, more anxious, and had a lower sensitivity to physical pain.
